scenes.text: How to tell *good fried chicken* before you order
Listen first. *A crust that crackles* was fried right.

scenes.sub: Good fried chicken takes 12 to 18 minutes. Chicken handed over instantly has been under a heat lamp.

scenes.text: A crust that pulls away clean
scenes.sub: Craggy and crisp, not a soggy layer stuck to the meat. That means the oil was hot enough.
Brined or marinated overnight. A bite with no crust should still taste like something.
Dark meat fries better, and a kitchen that pushes it knows what it's doing.

scenes.text: Walk in and smell. *Nutty is good. Sharp and burnt means old oil.*
